versions.content: Usage of McGroup Since the use cases for McGroup are considered as rather project specific and the specification how to generate A2L does not belong to AUTOSAR, not all possible constraints on the attributes and association owned by McGroup are specified in this document. Especially it is not standardized, how instances of McGroup s have to be derived from an M1 model of AUTOSAR soft- ware components or modules.
